recording.limitation: Estimated visual alignment: 25 fps quantization (~40 ms), first traced/encoded frame correspondence and browser/host clock sampling. No sub-frame accuracy is claimed.
recording.sourceBasis: Playwright 1.64.1 coreBundle.js: VideoRecorder passes frameSwapWallTime; FfmpegVideoRecorder emits timestamp minus creationTimeMs and writes creation_time metadata.

synchronization_note: Estimated cross-host alignment using the shortest measured HTTP round trip and server observed_at_utc; preserve RTT and 25 fps frame quantization uncertainty.
